FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 321
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Commissions
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/01/2024
House Bill 321 as introduced could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections
by an undetermined amount dependent on any decrease in license plate production due to the
provisions of this bill.
